messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — need to lock the Q2 GTM priorities. Main items: (1) PLG experiment slate, (2) sales commit numbers for SDR/AE handoff, (3) enablement sprint scope. Can we surface blockers?
Sam Nguyen: I'm +1. PLG experiments: trial-to-paid funnel test, onboarding checklist flow, and pricing nudges. Need MKT ops support for telemetry.
Ernie Chen: From product side, we can ship the onboarding checklist by week 3 but pricing nudges need API gating — ETA week 6. Also a small model tweak for conversational demos (low-risk rollout).
Liam O'Connor: Sales needs firm commit numbers for quota planning. Proposal below — feedback welcome:```json
{
  "SMB": 1100,
  "Mid-market": 320,
  "Enterprise": 28
}```
Aisling Byrne: Those look reasonable. We should reserve a 10% buffer for enablement ramp. Also recommend prioritizing playbooks for Mid-market reps.
Maya Patel: Agree on buffer. Sam — can marketing deliver playbook content and a 2-week onboarding webinar series?
Sam Nguyen: Yes, but we need clear product collateral from Ernie by Tue. Also need one shared customer use case (short doc).
Ernie Chen: I'll drop a 1-pager by Monday and a demo script by Tuesday. Can someone from sales mark must-have items for the playbook? @Liam O'Connor
Liam O'Connor: Will annotate the playbook checklist by EOD Monday. Priorities: 1) objection handling for latency/cost, 2) SLA/uptime expectations, 3) pricing tiers.
Maya Patel: For PLG telemetry, Sam — can you list events we need? minimal set: signup, first-API-call, demo-completion, purchase.
Sam Nguyen: Yep. Also want to capture referral-source and trial-length. Will coordinate with MKT ops.
Aisling Byrne: On rollout gating — propose canary for the checklist and pricing nudges with rollback window 48h. Product + infra to own rollback.
Ernie Chen: Noted. Runtime team to confirm canary routing. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary deploy slot for Wed 09:00 PST?
deploy-bot: Canary deploy window requested: Wed 09:00 PST. Confirmed slot reserved.
Maya Patel: Nice. Action items: Ernie 1-pager/demo (Mon), Liam annotate playbook (Mon EOD), Sam telemetry & ops (Tue), Marketing playbook draft + webinar plan (Tue), Product to confirm canary routing (Tue), deploy-bot scheduled canary (Wed 09:00).
Sam Nguyen: One more ask — can we run an A/B on trial length (7 vs 14 days) as part of the PLG slate? Low lift and high signal.
Liam O'Connor: Sales neutral, go for it. Need clear segmentation so AEs know sample.
Maya Patel: Ok let's finalize by Wed EOD. Anyone blocking timeline?
Aisling Byrne: No blockers from my side.
Ernie Chen: None.
Sam Nguyen: All good. I'll bake this into the plan and circulate a short doc with metrics/KPIs by end of day tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Perfect — thanks team. We'll reconvene after docs are in.
